instructions: Build the approved two-home Scavenger pair with distinct low roof profiles, broad blue and cream appliance doors, reclaimed timber, a shared uneven porch and visible load paths. Keep the side-by-side cottages visually separate in the 64-inch Room A view. Fit the 17 x 7 x 9 inch envelope. Keep all geometry presentation-only and omit Clockwork ornament.
tool: Blender component authoring with geometry-built timber, enamel repairs and overlapping PBR roof sheets.
material_method: Broad material blocks define the two cottage silhouettes at gameplay scale; procedural PBR patina adds close-range wood grain, chipped enamel and weathered sheet metal.

import_configuration.format: GLB with embedded PBR texture maps
import_configuration.up_axis: glTF Y up converted from Blender Z up
